main_text.p: moniū præclarum extat in oratione pro Cæcina, ubi Cicero C. Aquilij, & aliorū quorūdam Iurisconsultorū, qui secundum Cæcinam responderat, auctoritatem profert. itemque apud Paulum in L. Titius, 43. D. de aƈt. empt. ubi Domitij Vlpiani responsum, in iudicio lectum, profertur. Quapropter Cicero in Topicis, priuata iudicia maximarum rerum, in iurisconsultorum prudentia posita esse scribit: Nam & ad funt multum, inquit, & adhibentur in consilio, & patronis diligentibus ad eorum prudentiam confugientibus ha-stas

page.notes: The quotation marks "»" at the start of the lines from "posita" to the end are printed in the left margin; they are quotation marks, not notes, and are not transcribed as text beyond this remark. The running head is set in small heavy capitals and could not be read letter by letter. The long s has been normalised to s throughout. The last word is split across the line end as "ha-" / "ftas"; the word is completed on this page as "ha-stas".
